cells.gaps: Every coverage fact dates from 2020 to 2022 and nothing later says where clinics' reports are keyed. The 2021 plan has DHIS 2 deployed in a few first-contact establishments (CIV-025) without saying they enter their own reports, so T3 is not held and the 2020 statement that none do stands. No plan or finance fact falls inside the 36 months, no dated event inside the twelve, and the community flag rests on the platform publisher's own statement in systems.csv.
cells.note: DHIS2 is keyed at the departmental health directorate from the first-contact establishments' paper monthly reports, nationally, with hospitals keying their own: the stage 3 row. Stage 4 needs entry at the facility by more than half of primary clinics, and the evidence shows none.

cells.gaps: Digital Mag (October 2026, CIV-037) has 258 health facilities of unstated type using the record, and DISD (November 2025, CIV-038) says it was extended to first-contact establishments, but no source gives the tiers of the 258, a count of hospitals using it, or primary clinics using it in any district; extension is deployment, not use. The facts disagree on whether records are shared (CIV-021) or local (CIV-017), and the World Bank in September 2025 (CIV-009) and the September 2026 workshop reports (CIV-001 to CIV-004) call the record not yet in service nationwide.
cells.note: The DPI is in routine use at one general hospital and in 258 facilities of unstated type, and deployed at 9 national hospitals: some hospitals, the stage 2 row. Stage 3 needs most hospitals using it or primary clinics in some districts, and no source shows either.
